title: Nullable variables multiply rules
notes: S → ABCD, where each of A, B, C and D can vanish. Removing their ε-rules one at a time gives S every way of leaving some out: 15 right sides from one. Then the long ones are split into chains.
ops: S -> ABCD; A -> a | eps; B -> b | eps; C -> c | eps; D -> d | eps
